Crew found burned up stinger from UG dip switch on the high side switch.
Made repairs and all power was restored.

Observation: From IUC: Lines down vehicle hit them 7704993911

** Crew discovered Service Pole was hit by car **

Emergency Locate: 261121-001011

Spoke with with Cobb 911 and the police report # MA26018735.


** Crew Confirmed a car hit a service pole at 429 Cherokee St- Crew discovered that this damaged the Meter Can at that location .

Crew was able to explain to the customer that he will need an electrician to make repairs ,a 3 day was offered . Crew is pulling in new service wire, but electrician will need to complete repairs before energizing 429 Cherokee ST . 

Meter has been removed and released to Bryndall. Meter # 123719TNR
